record.population: 54,917 patients patch tested to paraphenylenediamine (PPD) by the North American Contact Dermatitis Group, 1994-2018
record.finding: 3,095 (5.6%) had an allergic reaction to PPD; hair dye was the source in 73.5%. Allergic patients had lower odds of being White (odds ratio 0.66) and higher odds of being over 40 and female. Of occupational reactions (8.3%), 72.8% were in hairdressers or cosmetologists.
record.note: Patients referred for patch testing, not the general population; PPD is one dye chemical.
